title: Where an initialised global lives

prereqs.why: The answer is the name of one section, and the question is which of three it is.

statement:
A C++ file at namespace scope contains:

```cpp
int counter = 7;
```

Name the ELF section of the compiled object file that holds those four bytes: **writable, and initialised to something other than zero**.

Give the section name as `readelf -S` prints it.
hints: Three candidates, and each is ruled in or out by two questions: is it writable, and does the file have to carry the bytes?
